purpose: Discover short-duration opportunistic long chromosomes that can profit while the independent A OR B OR C market-state architecture remains DEFENSIVE.
state_invariant: GA cannot declare crash, recovery, NORMAL, or modify A/B/C/R1.

source.laboratory: Consumed DEV50 only; only tickers present in reconstructed cache are eligible.

window_note: Window endpoints identify consumed retrospective laboratories only. They are never entry/exit features. Trades are simulated causally from each signal path.

chromosome.families: nonempty subset of observed candidate-signal families

execution.entry: Next available path open for IMMEDIATE; for PULLBACK_RECLAIM, after an observed pullback from signal entry price, enter at next-session open after close reclaims the specified fraction of that observed decline and confirmation requirement is satisfied.
execution.stop_target: Evaluated causally from post-entry daily OHLC. If stop and target are both touched in the same bar, use stop first (conservative ambiguity rule).
execution.timeout: Exit at close after max_hold_sessions if no earlier stop/target.

fitness.selection_principle: Prefer portable short-term profitability across declining-market episodes over one-episode maximization.

seeds.phase1_quality_lineage: Benchmark only; original executable semantics not assumed recovered.
seeds.phase1b_breakout_lineage: Benchmark only; original executable semantics not assumed recovered.

anti_overfit: No known trough/peak/recovery labels as chromosome features.
Do not allow one crash rally to dominate fitness.
Report null result if portability is absent.
